zh: 历史快照明细去重存储：快照不再每份都内嵌全部源表行，相同内容的表按内容压缩只存一份（放在已有的键值表里，升级不需要执行数据库脚本）；经基座写入的数据量随之大幅减少。旧快照在后台逐条转换，每条先校验能完整还原再写回。月报资料库读取单张表时只读那一份快照，不再把全部快照连同明细一起读出。
en: Deduplicated snapshot detail storage: snapshots no longer embed every source row; identical tables are compressed and stored once (in the existing key-value table, so upgrading needs no database script), which greatly reduces data written through the base. Older snapshots are converted in the background after verifying they restore exactly. The monthly report library now reads only the snapshot it needs instead of every snapshot with its rows.
